questions.question: The cost of an article is Rs. 480. It is to be sold at a profit of 12.5%. What is the selling price of the article?
questions.solution:
Given C.P = Rs. 480

Profit % = 12.5%

Since, S.P = C.P × (1 + profit%/100)

So, S.P = 480 × (1 + 12.5/100)

⇒ S.P = 480 × 9/8

∴ The selling price of the article is Rs. 540

questions.question: If 4A = 6B = 5C; then find the value of A : B : C.
questions.solution:
Let 4A = 6B = 5C = K

⇒ 4A = K, 6B = K and 5C = K

⇒ A = K/4, B = K/6 and C = K/5

Now, A : B : C = K/4 : K/6 : K/5

Since, LCM of 4, 6 and 5 = 60

⇒ Multiply (60/K) in each term of the above ratio

⇒ A : B : C = (K/4 × 60/k) : (K/6 × 60/k) : (K/5 × 60/k)

∴ A : B : C = 15 : 10 : 12

questions.question: Five years ago, the average age of four girls, was 7 years. A new girl is included then average present age becomes 13 years. Find the present age of the new girl.
questions.solution:
Let the sum of ages of four girls 5 years ago be X

⇒ X = 7 × 4 = 28

⇒ The sum of present ages of four girl = 28 + 5 × 4 = 48

Let the age of new girl be Y

⇒ 48 + Y = 13 × 5

∴ Y = 17 years

questions.question: The length, breadth and height of a cuboid are 18 cm, 24 cm and 4 cm respectively. The volume of cube is equal to the volume of given cuboid. Find the side of the cube.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length, breadth and height of a cuboid are 18 cm, 24 cm and 4 cm

**Concept used:**

The volume of cuboid = l × b × h 

Where l = length, b = breath, h = height,

The volume of cube = a³, where a is the sides of the cube

**Calculation:**

So, volume of cuboid = 18 × 24 × 4 = 12³

Since, volume of cube = volume of cuboid

⇒ (a)³ = 12³

⇒ a = 12 cm

**∴ The side of the cude is 12 cm**

questions.question: A train travelling at the speed of 108 km/h crosses a pole in 32 seconds. Find the length (in m) of the train.
questions.solution:
Given speed of train = 108 km/hour

⇒ Speed of train = 108 × 5/18 = 30 m/sec

Since, we know that

Distance = Speed × time

⇒ Distance = 30 × 32 = 960 m

∴ Length of train is 960 m

questions.question: A is twice as good at writing a novel as B. Together they can finish writing the novel in 24 days. In how many days can A alone write the novel?
questions.solution:
Let the time taken by A to write a novel be x days

So, the time taken by B to write the novel is 2x days

According to question,

They together can finish the work in 24 days

⇒ 1/x + 1/2x = 1/24

⇒ 3/2x = 1/24

⇒ x = 36 days

∴ A can write the whole novel in 36 days

questions.question: A man is walking at a speed of 12 km per hour. After every kilometre, he takes rest for 4 minutes. How much time (in minutes) will he take to cover a distance of 8 kilometres?
questions.solution:
Since the speed of man is 12 km per hour

⇒ 12 km distance can be covered by the man in 1 hour (60 minutes)

⇒ 1 km distance can be covered by the man in 60/12 minutes = 5 minutes

And he takes a rest for 4 minutes after every kilometre

⇒ He takes (5 + 4) minutes to cover 1 km

⇒ He will take (7 × 9) minutes to cover 7 km

∴ Total time to cover 8 km by the man will be (63 + 5) = 68 minutes
